description: Verification bundle: Brokkr's verify and review agents examine an already-delivered change (named in the feature text). No implement, no ship — evidence in, ruling out. The constitutional review invariants hold: review is unavoidable on the path to done, security-hold is a hard stop, security residuals never pass.

rules.reason: The delivered change does not verify; the ruling is the report.
Checks green; the review agent reads verified evidence.
Unresolved high-severity security findings in the delivered change. Risk acceptance is the operator's, never an agent's.
Residual severity above medium; the verification verdict is negative.
Security residuals never qualify as an acceptable verification outcome.
The read-only reviewer claims it changed code on a residual verdict: charter violation, park-grade defect in the verification itself.
Non-security residuals at or below medium: verified with named tracked debt. Omitted severity inputs fall here flagged — the operator reads the notes.
Verified clean. This bundle's reviewer never applies fixes.
The read-only reviewer claims it changed code: charter violation, park-grade defect in the verification itself.
